shared_elements: low-relief carving of a bordered rectangular panel
small human/anthropomorphic faces or heads shown in profile
dense repeated small-scale detail filling the field
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces are framed relief panels crowded with small carved detail, and both contain profile faces (a large winged anthropomorphic figure in A, tiny heads embedded in glyph blocks in B). Otherwise the content is quite different: A depicts a single dominant standing winged figure with a raised hand, plant/rosette motifs and finely incised feather and hair texture, while B is entirely non-figural in organisation, a strict grid of rounded, cartouche-like sign blocks in rows and columns with no scene or interaction between elements.
